# !!! THIS IS A GENERATED FILE !!! DON'T EDIT ME MANUALLY !!!
# Instead edit donico.yml and run bin/rake generate-files

variable "BUILD_DATE" {
  validation {
    condition = BUILD_DATE != ""
    error_message = "The variable 'BUILD_DATE' must not be empty."
  }
}

#########################
# BULLSEYE - ruby 3.2.0 #
#########################

target "bullseye-3-2-0-build" {
  dockerfile = "dockerfiles/3.2/Dockerfile"
  args = {
    BUILD_DATE = "${BUILD_DATE}"
    DISTRO_NAME = "bullseye"
    NODEJS_VERSION = "14.17.3"
    RUBY_VERSION = "3.2.0"
  }
  platforms = ["linux/amd64", "linux/arm64"]
  output    = [{ type = "docker" }]
  tags      = ["ruby/3.2.0/bullseye:${BUILD_DATE}"]
}

target "bullseye-3-2-0-push" {
  dockerfile = "dockerfiles/3.2/Dockerfile"
  args = {
    BUILD_DATE = "${BUILD_DATE}"
    DISTRO_NAME = "bullseye"
    NODEJS_VERSION = "14.17.3"
    RUBY_VERSION = "3.2.0"
  }
  platforms = ["linux/amd64", "linux/arm64"]
  output    = [{ type = "registry" }]
  tags      = [
    "registry.example.net/images/base/ruby:3.2.0-bullseye",
    "registry.example.net/images/base/ruby:latest-bullseye",
  ]
}
